en: Sepia-toned image showing a formally dressed aristocratic couple riding in an open horse-drawn carriage. The woman wears an elaborate hat and fur-trimmed coat and holds a large bouquet of flowers; the man is in a decorated military uniform with epaulettes and medals. The polished carriage lamps and wheels are prominent in the foreground. In the blurred background stands a large Baroque/neo-Baroque palace or official residence with mansard roof and many windows, giving a ceremonial, royal impression.
